reasoning_content:
Now I see the issue! The Kulturhuset scraper outputs:
- `title` (not `title_en`)
- `start_time` as full ISO timestamp
- `url` (not `ticket_url`)

But the normalizer expects:
- `title` → used for `title_en` (line 339)
- `start_time` → used directly (line 343)
- `url` → used for `ticket_url` (line 355)

So the mapping should work... Let me check if Kulturhuset events have title. Let me fetch a few events from the API and see what fields they have.

action.command:
curl -s --max-time 10 -X POST "https://elastic.kulturhusetstadsteatern.se/khst-events/_search" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"size": 3, "query": {"bool": {"must": [{"range": {"tixStartDate": {"gte": "now"}}}]}}}' | jq '.hits.hits[] | ._source | {title: .drupalTitle, name: .tixName, date: .tixStartDate}'
